feast.note: Her name page lists one other day, «26 января (Новомуч.)», the synaxis of the new martyrs and confessors of the Russian Church. One row per church is the schema, so that day is recorded here and she does not render on it.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 2 декабря ст. ст. — «Прмц. Мариониллы (1938)»

death.note: The year the day line closes with, and the only year this calendar gives her. She is the only saint on this day dated 1938.

names.note: The heading of days.pravoslavie.ru’s name page 14365, «Марионилла (Цейтлин), прмц.», with the grade word left off. The day line declines the forename and prints no surname. No other folder in this corpus holds either the forename or the surname.
